integrity: All hypotheses and quantifiers stated; infinite proof uses multiplicativity, a prime-cofactor bound, quadratic-residue implications and 2-adic valuations; independent finite divisor enumeration is corroborative.
limitations: Classification only for a distinct prime q times the square of a squarefree integer m >= 2; general equality and infinitude remain unresolved. Unindexed or partially accessible prior work is a residual originality risk.
title: Prime-cofactor rigidity for unitary–exponential divisor-sum equality on squarefree squares
